changelog:
super-Finance Knowledge Base v1.0.0

- Initial release of a comprehensive financial knowledge management system for institutions.
- Features document organization, dynamic knowledge graphs, semantic search, and intelligent Q&A.
- Enables rapid access to regulatory, product, and market insights to support decision-making and operational efficiency.
- Clearly positioned as advisory-only and requires human review; no executable code or persistent storage.
- Includes security notice and detailed description of pain points, core capabilities, and trigger keywords in English and Chinese.
summary: Comprehensive financial knowledge management system for institutions, featuring document organization, dynamic knowledge graphs, semantic search, and intelligent Q&A.
